# Legacy writer fixtures

Captured before serializer changes at checkout `910653f9ca6033b6a19be65bafcf89ba3c3c16e1`.
Command: `cargo test --test framing --no-default-features --features std,compression,experimental --locked`.
Each file contains distinct complete containers in hexadecimal emitted by its named
`tests/framing.rs` test; that test defines the exact configuration, inputs and flush
schedule. Tests compare bytes with these fixtures before independent wire parsing.
The C oracle checks raw members only. These files are not regenerated by tests.
